title: 나간 발자국이 없는 집, 힌터카이페크
disclaimer: 실제 사건 기록 기반 | 일부 내용은 전해지는 이야기입니다
credits: Memorial photo: Andreas Keller, via Wikimedia Commons (copyrighted free use)

jumpscare.img: a pale gaunt man's face staring out of the darkness of a wooden attic, wide eyes, horror film jump scare

lines.img: an isolated old Bavarian farmhouse with a barn in a snowy field at dusk, dark forest behind it
silhouette of an old farmer holding a lantern in a snowy farmyard at night, face not visible

lines.text: 숲에서 집까지 이어진 발자국. 그런데, 나간 발자국은 없었다고.
lines.img: a single line of footprints in fresh snow leading from a dark forest toward an old farmhouse door, no footprints going back, night
a dark wooden farmhouse attic with hay and rafters, thin beams of light through cracks, dust in the air

lines.text: 본 적 없는 신문이 놓여 있었고, 집 열쇠는 사라졌다고.
lines.img: an old 1920s German newspaper lying on a rough wooden kitchen table next to a candle, empty key hook on the wall
an old farmhouse at night in the snow with one dimly lit window, ominous, nobody outside

lines.text: 3월 31일 밤. 그 집에 있던 여섯 명이, 모두 살해됩니다.
그런데 그 뒤로도, 누군가 그 집에서 지냈다고 합니다.
lines.img: smoke rising from the chimney of a lonely snowy farmhouse at winter dusk, nobody around, eerie

lines.text: 가축은 먹이를 먹었고, 굴뚝에선 연기가 피어올랐습니다.
lines.img: cows standing in a dark old wooden barn at night, a lantern hanging on a post, hay on the floor, nobody visible
the door of an old barn standing slightly open in the snow, overcast daylight, footprints of several people
an old rusty mattock half hidden under hay in a pitch dark attic, a single beam of light

lines.text: 오늘 밤... 당신 집 다락은, 조용한가요?
lines.img: a ceiling attic hatch slightly open seen from below, pitch black darkness inside, old house at night
